project.name: collectb-identity
project.description: The Identity bounded context/module (design doc "Identity Service"): platform_user, identity_credential, role, permission, role_assignment JPA entities and repositories; the PlatformUserPrincipal/PlatformUserDetailsService authentication layer; the argon2id password encoder; and the embedded Spring Authorization Server (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT access tokens, refresh tokens) configuration. Packaged as a plain library jar (no spring-boot-maven-plugin/main class here) so that other bounded-context modules - Brand, Catalog, ADC, Ownership, etc. - can depend on it for authentication/authorization without depending on the deployable Platform API application itself. Per the design doc: "This milestone should produce a reusable identity layer that every other module can depend on."
